Retrieves the details of a single alert by its ID or entity value.

**You must provide exactly one of `id` or `entity`**. Providing neither or both returns HTTP 400.

Returns the full alert object including audit logs, tags, entity content, and a signed screenshot URL (expires in 1 hour).

Creates an alert for a specific entity (URL or phone number) within Doppel's Brand Protection product.

**Behavior:**
- If an alert already exists for the entity, the existing alert is returned (HTTP 200).
- If the alert exists but with a different brand than requested, returns HTTP 409.
- After creation, the alert is automatically processed through Doppel's triage workflow.

params.name: entity
params.description: The URL, phone number, or email of the alert to update. Mutually exclusive with `id`.

items.docs:
Updates an alert's information in Doppel's system. Works across all modules.

**You must provide exactly one of `id` or `entity`** to identify the alert. At least one field to update must be provided in the request body.

**Paired parameters:**
- `tag_action` and `tag_name` must both be provided together.
- `file_action` and `files` must both be provided together.

This endpoint submits referrer logs to Doppel for processing. These logs capture URLs that direct visitors to a site and may help identify threats or suspicious activity. Submitting a referrer log does not guarantee that an alert will be generated. Instead, the submitted URL will be analyzed as part of Doppel's referrer log processing.

params.name: search_key
params.description: Search alerts by URL. Currently only URL search is supported.

params.name: created_before
params.description: Filter alerts created before this date (ISO 8601 format).

params.name: created_after
params.description: Filter alerts created after this date (ISO 8601 format).

params.name: last_activity_timestamp
params.description: Filter alerts with last activity at or after this date (ISO 8601 format).

params.name: page
params.description: Page number for pagination (zero-indexed). Defaults to 0.

params.name: page_size
params.description: Number of alerts per page (default 30, max 200)

params.name: tags
params.description: Comma-separated list of tag names to filter alerts by.

items.docs:
Returns a paginated list of alerts across all modules, with support for filtering and sorting.

**Sorting:** If `sort_type` is provided, `sort_order` must also be provided. If neither is provided, defaults to `date_sourced` descending.

**Pagination:** Zero-indexed. Default page_size is 30, maximum is 200.

**Note:** In this endpoint's response, the alert timestamp field is named `last_activity_timestamp` (instead of `last_activity` as returned by GET /alert, PUT /alert, and POST /alert).
